title: Backend API & Multi-Tenant IDOR Adversarial Fuzzing

findings.title: No rate limiting middleware installed anywhere in the application
findings.description: No slowapi/rate-limiter dependency or middleware exists anywhere in fe-signalloom. 50 rapid identical unauthenticated requests never receive a 429.
evidence: static search: rg -ni "ratelimit|rate_limit|slowapi|limiter" across all app .py files returns no limiter implementation
findings.remediation: Add an ASGI rate limiter scoped at minimum to JWT-verification-failure paths and the external-agent enrollment/token endpoints.

findings.title: Settings.cors_allowed_origins declared but never wired to CORSMiddleware
findings.description: config.py declares an intended CORS allow-list but main.py never installs CORSMiddleware; the setting is dead configuration.
findings.remediation: Wire CORSMiddleware using the existing setting, or remove the setting if CORS is intentionally handled at the Gateway.

findings.title: routers.policies's own CEL-validate/evaluate/bundle routes have no auth dependency; currently unreachable only by router-registration-order accident
findings.description: validate_policy_expression / evaluate_policies / register_bundle / rollback_bundle declare no auth dependency. They are shadowed at runtime by routers.policy_engine's authenticated wildcard proxy route, registered earlier in app.routes. This is an accidental consequence of install_compatibility_api/install_policy_engine_api call order and an identity-based dedup guard, not a declared contract.
evidence: tests/test_tenant_authorization_matrix.py::test_policies_router_own_routes_are_unreachable_dead_code (runtime: confirmed 401 via shadowing, with an authenticated-token control case confirming the proxy answers)
findings.remediation: Delete the dead routers.policies routes, or give them their own explicit Depends(authenticated_tenant) so safety does not depend on routing order.

findings.title: Ad-hoc per-router error messages occasionally include raw exception text
findings.exploitable_today: partial (no stack trace/schema observed, only exception message text)
findings.description: A broad except Exception path returns f"Failed to parse request: {exc}" directly, inconsistent with api_compat.py's centralized generic error envelope. Tested with malformed UTF-8 input: no path/stack leak observed, only a UnicodeDecodeError description.
findings.remediation: Route through api_compat.install_api_exception_handlers's generic envelope instead of ad-hoc per-router messages.

findings.title: threading.Lock held across an await in enroll_host_handler's in-memory fallback path
findings.description: The in-memory fallback branch holds a plain threading.Lock across an await on _audit_log_enrollment(None, ...). Verified not exploitable today: that await never truly suspends when conn is None (its only real awaits are gated behind `if conn is not None`), proven empirically by a 16-task true asyncio-concurrency race completing cleanly within a 15s bound. Fragile invariant, not an enforced one -- a future change adding a real await on that path would reintroduce a single-coroutine deadlock.
findings.remediation: Replace _HOST_ENROLL_LOCK with an asyncio.Lock for the in-memory path, or document/assert the no-real-await invariant explicitly.

findings.title: Pre-existing duplicate router registration breaks route-inventory invariant tests (not caused by this card)
findings.severity: LOW (test-health / build integrity, not a security boundary bypass)
findings.status: confirmed pre-existing on integration branch, reproduced with this card's new files entirely absent from disk
findings.component: main.py install_*_api call sequence (routers.agents/discovery/policy_engine/federation each mounted twice: once via api_compat.install_compatibility_api, once via their own main.py-level install call)
findings.description: FastAPI emits 'Duplicate Operation ID' warnings for routers.agents's routes; this inflates route counts past what several pre-existing inventory-exactness tests expect (test_tenant_isolation.py::test_the_route_sweep_covers_every_authenticated_api_route, test_eap_default_deny.py's pinned-inventory guards, and others). Reproduced in complete isolation with all four of this card's new test files removed from disk, and with only the affected pre-existing files run -- confirms this is a baseline defect on integration/slaat-whole-system-adversarial, not a regression introduced by SLAAT-P1-2. A separate pre-existing bug (list_discovery_workloads() got an unexpected keyword argument 'request') was also reproduced in isolation in tests/test_connectors.py::test_connector_toggle_syncs_with_discovery, likewise confirmed unrelated to this card.
evidence: Full-suite run with new files present: 66 failed, 2357 passed, 104 skipped (/tmp/slaat-full-run3.log at generation time)

Isolated re-run of only the four affected pre-existing files (test_tenant_isolation.py, test_eap_default_deny.py, test_eap_forged_headers.py, test_eap_anonymous_surface.py) with this card's four new test files moved off disk entirely: IDENTICAL 14 failures reproduced
Isolated single-test reproduction of a second, unrelated pre-existing failure (test_connectors.py::test_connector_toggle_syncs_with_discovery) with zero SLAAT-P1-2 files loaded
findings.remediation: Out of this card's merge boundary (no production router-wiring changes). Recommend a dedicated hardening card dedupe main.py's install_*_api calls against api_compat.install_compatibility_api's inclusions.
findings.remediation_phase: unscheduled -- flag for triage, not SLAAT-P2-2 specifically

no_findings_confirmed_hardened.description: All six dynamic-WHERE-clause f-string SQL sites verified to interpolate only $N placeholders and fixed identifiers; SQL-injection-shaped values confirmed inert as ordinary data.

alg:none, RS256->HS256 confusion, kid substitution/omission, signature stripping, payload tampering, duplicate-key/non-object/JSON-constant payloads, expired/not-yet-valid tokens, wrong aud/iss/azp, and forged tenant claims all fail closed.

no_findings_confirmed_hardened.area: Multi-tenant IDOR/BOLA (connectors, agents, external-agent registration, host enrollment)
no_findings_confirmed_hardened.description: Cross-tenant probes against 8 routers not reached by prior EAP/DB_ROUTES sweeps found no data leak or cross-tenant mutation.
True asyncio-concurrency race (16 tasks) yields exactly one winner with no deadlock; bit-flip token tampering rejected without burning the real token; cross-agent token binding enforced.
